workflow.name: Publish LinkedIn posts from RSS using Ollama, PostgreSQL and Telegram approval
workflow.description:
This workflow automatically converts incoming RSS/news articles into structured, AI-enriched content records. It uses a local AI model to summarize articles, extract metadata, and classify content before storing it in PostgreSQL. A human-in-the-loop approval step via Telegram ensures only validated content is published to LinkedIn, maintaining quality and brand safety.

⚙️ How it works
Fetch RSS feed articles → AI summarizes content using Ollama → Extracts category, keywords, sentiment, and key points → Stores structured data in PostgreSQL → Sends content to Telegram for human approval → User approves or rejects → Approved content is marked in database → Automatically publishes approved posts to LinkedIn

📦 Requirements

n8n (latest version)
PostgreSQL database
Telegram Bot API credentials
LinkedIn Developer App (OAuth2)
Ollama (local AI runtime) with model like qwen2.5:3b
RSS feed source (e.g., Ars Technica or any news feed)

📊 Database Table Required: rss_feed_articles

Stores AI-processed articles, metadata, and approval status for controlled publishing workflow.

parameters.text:
=You are an AI news summarization agent.

Your task is to analyze the provided RSS/news article data and generate a clean structured JSON response.

Input Data:
Creator: {{ $json.creator }}
Title: {{ $json.title }}
Link: {{ $json.link }}
Published Date: {{ $json.pubDate }}
Content: {{ $json.content }}

Instructions:
1. Read and understand the article content.
2. Generate a concise summary in 3-5 sentences.
3. Extract the main topic/category.
4. Identify important keywords.
5. Detect sentiment if possible (Positive, Neutral, Negative).
6. Return ONLY valid JSON.
7. Do not include markdown or explanations.

Output JSON format:

{
  "creator": "",
  "title": "",
  "link": "",
  "published_date": "",
  "summary": "",
  "category": "",
  "keywords": [],
  "sentiment": "",
  "important_points": []
}

parameters.content:
# Human Governance Layer:
## • Telegram Approval Workflow
## • Manual Content Validation
## • Publishing Control

#  An AI-powered Human-in-the-Loop content automation workflow that collects RSS news feeds, generates structured summaries using local AI models, routes content through Telegram for human approval, and automatically publishes approved posts to LinkedIn.

## The system combines AI efficiency with human governance to ensure high-quality, controlled, and brand-safe social media publishing.

# SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS

## Core Platform
- PostgreSQL Database
- Telegram Bot API
- LinkedIn Developer Application
- Ollama Local AI Runtime

---

## AI Models
- qwen2.5:3b (Recommended)
- Any Ollama-supported LLM

---

## Required Integrations
- Telegram Bot
- LinkedIn OAuth2
- PostgreSQL Connection
- RSS Feed Sources
- Ollama API Access

---

## Database Tables Required

### 1. rss_feed_articles
Stores processed AI-generated article summaries and approval status.

# Database Schema — rss_feed_articles

## Table: `rss_feed_articles`

Stores AI-processed RSS news articles, metadata, approval status, and publishing information.

| Column Name       | Data Type      | Constraints / Default           | Description |
|------------------|----------------|---------------------------------|-------------|
| id               | SERIAL         | PRIMARY KEY                     | Unique article identifier |
| creator          | TEXT           | NULLABLE                        | Author or creator of the article |
| title            | TEXT           | NOT NULL                        | News article title |
| link             | TEXT           | NOT NULL                        | Original article URL |
| published_date   | TIMESTAMP      | NULLABLE                        | Original publication date |
| summary          | TEXT           | NULLABLE                        | AI-generated article summary |
| category         | VARCHAR(100)   | NULLABLE                        | Detected news category/topic |
| keywords         | TEXT[]         | NULLABLE                        | Extracted keywords from article |
| sentiment        | VARCHAR(20)    | NULLABLE                        | Sentiment analysis result |
| important_points | TEXT[]         | NULLABLE                        | Key highlights extracted by AI |
| is_approved      | BOOLEAN        | DEFAULT TRUE                    | Human approval status |
| created_at       | TIMESTAMP      | DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP       | Record creation timestamp |

---

## SQL Schema

```sql
CREATE TABLE rss_feed_articles (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    creator TEXT,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    link TEXT NOT NULL,
    published_date TIMESTAMP,
    summary TEXT,
    category VARCHAR(100),
    keywords TEXT[],
    sentiment VARCHAR(20),
    important_points TEXT[],
    is_approved BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
